credits_text: High in Iron. Low on Air. In Too Deep. A Pontus Films Release. Starring Mike Doley, Martin G. Kruse. Directed by Chris Bender, Jonathan Dicker, John Gardner, Jeremy Miller, Thomas Nichols, Robert Ridge, Sam Raimi, Rob Reiner, David Schwimmer, Craig Zisk. Produced by Laura Palmer and Tom Hillman. Written by Pontus Peters.
description: The poster features a large open mouth with a submarine emerging from it against a red background, with bold white text reading "Subferatu" and a tagline.
